exercise.name: Ransomware Incident — Tabletop
exercise.description: A guided tabletop exercise: detect, contain and recover from an Akira-style ransomware intrusion, coordinating SOC, IT and management.
exercise.expanded: Objectives: exercise detection of initial access, decision-making on isolation, invocation of the IR plan, stakeholder communication and recovery-from-backup validation.

inject_flow.description: SIEM raises a mass-encryption alert on a file server.
Decide whether to isolate the affected VLAN and pull the crown-jewel DB offline.
Validate offline backups and plan recovery; brief executives and (if required) the regulator.

inject_evaluation.result: Ransomware mass-encryption alert triaged and confirmed
Affected segment isolated; crown-jewel DB protected
Backups validated, recovery plan approved, stakeholders briefed
